title: A site is briefly down, and a site drops an edit
input: Listify fails its next two page loads. Later CityPages answers OK to the approved edit but does not store it.
expected: The agent waits and retries the outage until the site answers. For the lost edit it re-sends the same owner-approved change once and verifies it. Both are visible in the trace.
actual: outage retried; lost write re-sent; B holiday VERIFIED
explanation: Actual result matches the expected result.

checks.name: The agent retried the site that was down
Listify was read once it answered
The agent noticed the edit was dropped and re-sent the same approved change
It is VERIFIED after the re-send, and nothing else was written
The re-send is in the audit log
